title: Map Interchange, Round-Trip, Campaign Atlas, Review, Versions & Publishing
objective: Implement map-specific structured packages and representable flattened/vector outputs, VTI/MAI external interchange, justified GeoJSON-class mapping, print-at-scale output, external-editor round-trip, linked campaign/world atlas packaging, unsupported-semantics retention/loss reporting, map-specific review/conflict projections, and publish/archive adapters over existing ARI/PCA/Packet-07 infrastructure.

publish and archive adapters over ARI/PCA/PDCP Packet 07 infrastructure

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after MCS-18 exact-tree publication. No cross-program rotation gate supersedes the surviving MCS strict order, so MCS-19 is selected.
MCS-19 absorbs baseline MCS-19 and MCS-20 and owns map-specific interchange/round-trip/atlas/review/version/publish adapter behavior only.
ARI, PCA-15 and PDCP Packet 07 remain shared owner dependencies; MCS-19 must adapt to them rather than create replacement generic packaging, publication or review authority.
Unsupported semantics must be retained or explicitly reported as loss; flattened output must never be represented as lossless when source semantics cannot be preserved.
External-editor round-trip and GeoJSON-class mapping are used only where representable and justified, with provenance and fidelity declarations preserved.
MCS-19 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
MCS-21 and downstream work remain unauthorized by this selection.
The parallel ui-implementation lane, including UISR-01 if still active, remains independent and is not selected or modified by this product-development closeout.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in the product-development lane. On that command, governed-start MCS-19 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MCS-19 is selected_not_started after fresh post-MCS-18 DAG/backlog reconciliation; no bounded MCS-19 execution is active.
